description: Parses Home Assistant Core log lines read from the journal by the Elastic Agent app. See elastic_agent/DOCS.md.

script.if: ctx.message instanceof String && ctx.message.contains('Traceback (most recent call last):')
script.source: String m = ctx.message; String nl = String.valueOf((char) 10); int start = m.indexOf('Traceback (most recent call last):'); String trace = m.substring(start).trim(); String last = trace.substring(trace.lastIndexOf(nl) + 1).trim(); int colon = last.indexOf(':'); Map error = new HashMap(); error.put('stack_trace', trace); error.put('type', colon > 0 ? last.substring(0, colon) : last); if (colon > 0) { error.put('message', last.substring(colon + 1).trim()); } ctx.error = error; if (start > 0) { ctx.message = m.substring(0, start).trim(); }
